tagline: Build clean stacks, rescue messy boards, and chase long combos.
gameplaySummary: Tetris Deluxe rewards rhythm and placement discipline: you cycle falling pieces into clean wells, set up line clears, and decide when to burn a piece just to survive.

difficulty.summary: Early play is relaxed, but the pace ramps up as your stack rises and piece decisions become more punishing.

tips: Keep one lane open for long pieces whenever possible.
Flatten the stack before chasing a big combo.
Use quick drops carefully—speed helps until it locks you into a bad placement.
